basic_details.job_title: Hoshiarpur District Court Stenographer Grade III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Ten posts of Stenographer Grade III on adhoc basis are to be filled by the Office of the District and Sessions Judge, Hoshiarpur, at fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 29,200/-. Applications must be received in the office by 05:00 PM on 2 December 2026; incomplete or late applications will be rejected. The notice does not print a postal address or an application form and refers candidates to hoshiarpur.dcourts.gov.in for the detailed terms and conditions.

age_limit.details: Candidates should be between the age of 18 to 37 years as on 01.01.2026. Relaxation will be given as per instructions of Punjab Government; the notice does not list the category-wise relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The Office of the District and Sessions Judge, Hoshiarpur heads the Hoshiarpur Sessions Division in Punjab. The public notice was issued under the signature of the District and Sessions Judge, Hoshiarpur, and was sent for publication in The Tribune on 17.11.2026 and for display on the notice boards of all Sessions Divisions of Punjab State.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes to the Office of the District and Sessions Judge, Hoshiarpur. The notice does not print a full postal address, an application form or the mode of sending; it says that the detailed terms and conditions are on the official website https://hoshiarpur.dcourts.gov.in . Applications must be received by 05:00 PM on 2 December 2026, and the office will not be responsible for any postal delay or wrong delivery. Documents named in the notice Application form with the candidate's contact number and Email ID (both must be mentioned). Original testimonials, to be brought on the date of the test/interview.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 10 posts are of Stenographer Grade III on adhoc basis, initially for a period of six months or till regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier. The category-wise break-up as printed: The post of a reserved category will be offered to a candidate of the General category if no suitable candidate from the reserved categories is found eligible, as per law, whatever permissible. A degree of Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science or equivalent thereto from a recognized university. Pass a test at a speed of 80 W.P.M in English shorthand and 20 W.P.M in transcription of the same. Proficiency in computers (Word Processing and Spreadsheets). Candidates should be between the age of 18 to 37 years as on 01.01.2026. Relaxation will be given as per instructions of Punjab Government; the notice does not list the category-wise relaxation. The post carries fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 29,200/-. The notice does not mention any allowances. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will appear for a test of shorthand and proficiency in computer on 16 December 2026. The notice describes this as the test/interview for the post of Stenographer Grade III (Adhoc), to be conducted in the office of the District and Sessions Judge, Hoshiarpur on 16 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. All candidates must appear with their original testimonials on the date fixed for the test/interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing. Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be selected. The office reserves the right to alter, modify or change any term and condition, including the selection criteria.

faq.question: Q1. How many Stenographer Grade III vacancies are there in Hoshiarpur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 posts of Stenographer Grade III on adhoc basis, spread over General, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Caste (Majbi), women, ex-servicemen, Backward Class (ESM) and Person with Disability (Lower Limb) categories.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 05:00 PM on 2 December 2026; incomplete or late applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Stenographer Grade III post?
faq.answer: A BA or BSc degree or equivalent from a recognized university, passing a test at 80 W.P.M in English shorthand and 20 W.P.M in transcription, and proficiency in computers (Word Processing and Spreadsheets).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates should be between 18 and 37 years as on 01.01.2026, with relaxation as per instructions of Punjab Government.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Hoshiarpur District Court Stenographer Grade III?
faq.answer: The post carries fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 29,200/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on adhoc basis, initially for six months or till regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the test?
faq.answer: The test of shorthand and proficiency in computer (test/interview) will be held in the office of the District and Sessions Judge, Hoshiarpur on 16 December 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. What should candidates bring to the test?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their original testimonials; no TA/DA will be paid for appearing.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the list of rejected applications be published?
faq.answer: The list of rejected/incomplete applications will be displayed on the official website of the Hoshiarpur Sessions Division by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What details must be written in the application form?
faq.answer: All applicants must mention their contact number and Email ID in the application form.
